name: Research Workflow Pack
format: Editable Markdown files in a ZIP archive

files.name: 00-start-here.md
files.title: Start here
files.description: Choose a research question, make a working copy, and follow the first-review walkthrough.

files.name: 01-research-brief.md
files.title: Research brief
files.description: Define the question, scope, evidence threshold, and boundaries before collecting information.

files.name: 02-evidence-register.md
files.title: Evidence register
files.description: Connect claims to sources, definitions, dates, units, and any conflicting evidence.

files.name: 03-assumptions-and-contradictions.md
files.title: Assumptions & contradictions
files.description: Document what you infer, what would change your view, and where sources disagree.

files.name: 04-quarterly-review.md
files.title: Quarterly review
files.description: Compare like-for-like reporting periods and prepare a short, traceable research memo.

files.name: 05-change-log-and-handoff.md
files.title: Change log & handoff
files.description: Keep a history of revisions and leave clear next steps for your future self.

files.name: 06-ai-verification.md
files.title: AI verification workflow
files.description: Use a bounded extraction prompt and audit its output against the original text.

files.name: 07-fictional-worked-example.md
files.title: Worked example
files.description: Follow a fictional company from source excerpts to evidence, contradictions, and a qualified conclusion.

files.name: 08-operating-routine.md
files.title: Operating routine
files.description: Set review triggers, file conventions, maintenance limits, and a repeatable quality check.

files.name: 09-use-and-support.md
files.title: Use & support guide
files.description: Understand the file format, permitted use, product boundaries, and troubleshooting steps.
